new_page.description: Search Vancouver detached houses for sale. Compare Dunbar, Kerrisdale, Renfrew and Grandview sold prices, and see what the R1-1 zone allows on a house lot.

faq.q: How much does a house cost in Vancouver?
faq.a: It depends on the side. Vancouver West neighbourhoods like Dunbar ($2,947,384) and Kerrisdale ($3,136,500) are near $3,000,000, while Renfrew ($1,620,000) and Knight ($1,710,000) are on the East Side. The October 2026 benchmark was $2,899,700 West and $1,610,700 East.

faq.q: Which Vancouver neighbourhood has the most house sales?
faq.a: Dunbar, with 96 sales, then Renfrew with 89 and Kitsilano with 69.

faq.q: Which Vancouver houses sell the fastest?
faq.a: Grandview Woodland had a median of 7 days. Renfrew took 15 and Kitsilano 18. Shaughnessy took 62.
It is the zone that replaced nine RS zones on October 17, 2023, for about 65,000 lots. It allows a house with a suite or laneway house, a duplex, character retention and multiplexes.

faq.q: Can I build a multiplex on a Vancouver house lot?
faq.a: Sometimes. It needs rear-lane access, a site outside a designated flood plain and a lot that was a single lot of record before October 17, 2023.

faq.q: Is there a vacancy tax in Vancouver?
faq.a: The City’s Empty Homes Tax is 3% of assessed value for a home that is not occupied or rented.

blocks.text: This search lists detached houses for sale across the city of Vancouver, on the West Side and the East Side. Condos and townhomes have their own searches, and the North Shore and Burnaby are not included.

1,243 Vancouver houses closed in the year to October 22, 2026: 587 in Vancouver West and 656 in Vancouver East. The sold records report Vancouver by neighbourhood, so you get a median per neighbourhood instead of one city number. The Home Price Index benchmark for a typical detached home was $2,899,700 in Vancouver West and $1,610,700 in Vancouver East in October 2026.
The West Side: Vancouver West neighbourhoods

West Side houses start high. Shaughnessy had the highest median, $4,817,500, and took 62 days to sell. MacKenzie Heights ($3,188,000), Kerrisdale ($3,136,500) and Point Grey ($3,050,000) all sit above $3,000,000. Dunbar had the most sales, 96, at $2,947,384, and Kitsilano had 69 at $2,680,000.

blocks.text: The East Side: Vancouver East neighbourhoods

East Side medians run from $1,510,000 in Collingwood to $1,980,000 in Fraser, among neighbourhoods with 20 or more sales. Renfrew had 89 sales at $1,620,000, Knight 62 at $1,710,000 and South Vancouver 56 at $1,675,000. Grandview Woodland is the one to watch: 63 sales, a median of $1,900,000 and just 7 days to sell, in houses with a median build year of 1927. Killarney sold at $1,840,000 on 4,835 sq ft.

blocks.text: What the R1-1 zone allows on a Vancouver house lot

On October 17, 2023 Vancouver replaced nine RS zones with a single R1-1 zone for about 65,000 lots. R1-1 allows a house with a secondary suite or a laneway house, a duplex, character retention, and multiplexes of 3 to 6 strata units or up to 8 rental units.

The multiple-dwelling option is conditional. It needs rear-lane access, a site outside a designated flood plain, and a lot that was a single lot of record before October 17, 2023. New houses, duplexes and multiplexes also need a detention tank for stormwater from July 1, 2025.
The Vancouver Plan became part of the Official Development Plan on March 12, 2026. In the Renfrew area, the Rupert and Renfrew Station Area Plan was approved on July 8, 2025.
Costs and rules that follow a Vancouver house
Vancouver’s Empty Homes Tax is 3% of assessed value for a home that is not occupied or rented. The City’s Tenant Relocation and Protection Policy applies citywide when a rented house is redeveloped.

items.t: Check the lot’s zone, and the lane, before counting on a laneway house or multiplex.
Ask whether a house is a character house with retention incentives.
Add the detention tank to a redevelopment budget.
Confirm tenant rules if the house is rented.
